name: Simulate Demographic History
description: Simulate DNA sequences with specified demographic and coalescent histories using msprime.
detailed_description: Simulate DNA sequences with specified demographic and coalescent histories using msprime.
when_to_use: When you need simulate demographic history analysis

parameters.num_samples: [Optional] Number of sample sequences to simulate (default: 10)
parameters.sequence_length: [Optional] Length of the simulated sequence in base pairs (default: 100000)
parameters.demographic_model: [Optional] Type of demographic model to simulate (constant, bottleneck, expansion, contraction, sawtooth) (default: constant)
parameters.demographic_params: [Optional] Parameters specific to the chosen demographic model
parameters.coalescent_model: [Optional] Type of coalescent model to use (kingman, beta) (default: kingman)
parameters.output_file: [Optional] Filename to save the simulated sequences in VCF format (default: simulated_sequences.vcf)
